(sermon, rosary and benediction will take place) also, each morning and evening the sacrament of reconciliation will be available. tuesday - opening evening in st. joseph’s church wednesday - evening service in st. mary’s church thursday (evening) - st. joseph’s - sacrament of the sick & st. martin relics. those who are sick and housebound are encouraged to attend, if possible, can a family member transport them to the church. friday - st. mary’s - youth evening. (prayers led by parish youth) saturday - mass - st. mary’s church at 10am. usual weekend masses sunday (all saints) - st. mary’s - adoration evening. (blessing of roses) - 6pm. monday (all souls) - st. joseph’s - (ceremony for the deceased - evening at 7.30pm). monday (all souls) - morning mass in st. mary’s church at 7am. 10am mass in both churches. evening - close of mission in st. joseph’s church at 7.30pm. refreshments/social gathering - glenullin - wednesday morning after 10am mass in community hall. ballerin - sunday after devotions in the errigal hall. schools will participate in morning 10am masses in each church on all souls day. errigal

baptism dates: the next baptism dates are saturday 7th november in st. mary’s church at 5pm and st. joseph’s church on sunday 8th november at 12.30pm. the baptismal programme for parents/guardians will take place in the parochial house on wednesday 4th november at 7pm. please register to attend the baptismal programme by friday 30th october using the parish email address, this will indicate to the baptismal team the numbers who will attend the baptismal programme. errigal youth group: parish gift (growing in faith together) - grow closer to god, connect with friends, get involved in your community and discover your gifts! saturdays directly after the vigil mass in october and november in glenullin gac (small hall) (october) ballerin errigal hall (november). registration available in qr code available in community apps. sacrament of reconciliation: sacrament of reconciliation (confession) available after the vigil mass on request. parish envelopes: the new cycle of envelopes has now been distributed. those who contribute to the parish by standing order or currently receive envelopes - thank you for your generosity towards the parish! if you wish further information regarding setting up a standing order or the use of envelopes. please contact using the parish email address (
), or telephone 29558251. (voicemail available) st anne's conference of svp: are looking for volunteers for our thrift shop. if you would like to join our team, please phone

to leave your name and telephone no and we will be in contact with you. thank you. confirmation candidates gathering dates: the autumn gathering of the confirmation classes (p7’s) from both local schools will take place on - tuesday 3rd november - (st. mary’s church/errigal hall) tuesday 24th november (provisional date) - (glenullin community centre). each evening from 7pm - 8.30pm. parental consent forms will be required for those who gather it will be obtained via each school. mass cards (pre-signed): signed mass cards for all occasions are available in the side porch of st. mary’s church as requested by parishioners. a suggested donation of £5 is requested with the name of the recipient in a brown envelope included. please put the brown envelope in the st. vincent de paul box, where it will be retrieved and the monies and mass intention will be offered locally or by another priest. parish safeguarding: vetting process will take place on the first saturday of every month after the vigil mass. this will be to re-vet all existing volunteers as a new requirement from the diocese. if you are over 18 and volunteer as a sacristan /choir leader /children’s liturgy helper or baptism group helper for the parish please attend a meeting, on saturday 7th november in ballerin parochial house 6:45pm-7:45pm, at your convenience. please bring 3 forms of id with you to the meeting for verification purposes. these will be scanned for parish records. nb: most of the youth ministry volunteers have been recently vetted and therefore do not need to attend.
